changelog:
v1.12.0 Arcade & Games Section Upgrade:
• Tic-Tac-Toe Smart AI: Ported web heuristic engine with 3 difficulty modes (Casual, Balanced, and Unbeatable with fork creation/blocking)
• Visual Win Highlights: Highlights winning 3-in-a-row tiles in Tic-Tac-Toe and 4 connected discs in Connect Four
• Connect Four VS AI: Play solo against a smart AI opponent with instant win/block and column heuristics
• Retro Snake Swipe Controls: Smooth swipe/drag gesture controls anywhere on the board
• Tactile Haptics: Native vibrations for cell moves, disc drops, eating snake food, wins, and draws
• Persistent Game Stats: Win/loss/draw records and high scores saved locally across sessions
